_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-20. CardID = 17600 + idx; 321 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 21). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card. Bloody Mary's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the turtles', Doctor Strange's and the rest: only deck.identity (data/tts/bloody-mary.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): BLOODY MARY, MELEE, START HEALTH 16, MOVE 3; special ability 'At the start of your turn, if you have exactly 3 cards in hand, gain 1 action.' NO sidekick: unmatched-memory lists a 'Patroclus' sidekick with hasSidekicks false (a slip: he is Achilles' sidekick); it is not on the hero card nor in the savegame (the bag holds one miniature and one life dial). The overlay says sidekicks [] so the importer drops it.

Copies (xN printed on each card), type, value and boost match unmatched-memory for all 13 titles (30 cards). Discrepancy (the real card wins): Closer Than She Appears reads 'Move Bloody Mary up to 1 space' where unmatched-memory has 'Move your fighter up to 1 space'. Every card carries the BLOODY MARY band (none ANY): the restriction changes nothing while she has no sidekicks.
